notes.title: SPELLHACK!! is out now!!
notes.content:
SPELLHACKERS!!

The time has come! [b]SPELLHACK!! is available to play right now![/b] Doom City needs your help, and only you can hack these spells.

To celebrate the launch, the game is 20% off!

This has been a huge labor of love, and it's very surreal to finally send it out into the wild.


The full version of the game includes:
[list]
[*]     A Story Mode to ease into the pace and mechanics 
[*]     A Challenge Mode with 5 levels to really test your skills! 
[*]     150+ Technospells to collect and install 
[*]     50+ Summoned Beasts to repel 
[*]     A huge variety of items to collect and events to encounter 
[*]     Graphics so good you'll forget its just a game 
[*]     Characters with no ulterior motives! 
[*]     And more!! 
[/list]

I hope you enjoy it!

- Computer Dream (Andreas)

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!!
notes.content:
Hey Spellhackers!!

Over the past couple months, there's been a few small updates to the demo, but this is a big one!

[b]There's been a full redesign of the damage mod system.[/b]

Instead of +1 Mods and Lethal Mods, you can now gain Stable Mods and Quick Mods. In the new system, the damage added is the total of your Stable and Quick mods combined, so you can expect to pull off some crazy combos!

But, there's a catch, only Stable Mods will stick around if you don't use them. You'll lose any Quick Mods you didn't use at the end of each turn. So plan carefully!

That's all for now, keep an eye out for an even bigger demo update before the Steam Next Fest in October!!

As always, if you have any feedback, ideas, etc please check out the [url=https://discord.com/invite/BGrbk27eh5]Discord[/url]!

- Computer Dream

notes.title: SPELLHACK!! has a demo!!
notes.content:
Yo Spellhackers!!

[b]SPELLHACK!! Now has a free demo for you test your skills![/b]
It's been a long time coming, and I'm happy to finally share it with the world!

A run in the demo is about half the length as in the final game, and the events available during the daytime are limited. However, a large number of Technospells and enemy Beasts are available to play with! Please consider wishlisting the game if you enjoyed the demo!

I plan on keeping the Demo up indefinitely, and updating it while working on the full game.
If you have any feedback, ideas, etc please join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/BGrbk27eh5]Discord[/url].

Until next time!

- Computer Dream
